title: FinancialML CreditDefaultSPR

stats.done_summary: Completed FinancialML CreditDefaultSPR research task. Conducted comprehensive data analysis revealing position-specific patterns in symbolic sequences. Implemented multiple feature engineering approaches (comprehensive features, pattern-informed features, simplified key features) and evaluated various ML models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM, Neural Networks). Best model achieved test AUC of 0.5223 vs baseline of 0.72. Generated full research report with methodology, results, visualizations, and discussion. All code, intermediate results, and final report deliverables are in the workspace.
